meta.title: Wetherspoons Southampton: pubs, menu and prices guide
meta.description: Compare Wetherspoons Southampton pubs on High Street, London Road and in Bitterne, with menu choices, breakfast guidance and tips for checking prices.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Southampton across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose where to go and what to order. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Compare The Standing Order, The Giddy Bridge and The Red Lion, then check how local pricing, breakfast service and club days work. National menu choices include burgers, curries, fish and chips and pizza. Use the individual pub’s current menu to confirm your choices before ordering.
quickAnswer: Our Southampton guide lists {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs across {areaCount} areas: The Standing Order on High Street, The Giddy Bridge on London Road and The Red Lion in Bitterne. Choose the location that suits your plans, then check that pub’s menu before ordering. The national menu is broadly shared, but each pub sets its own prices.

areas.text: The Standing Order is the listed Wetherspoons on High Street in Southampton. It suits anyone whose plans already include High Street and who wants to compare familiar national menu choices. Check this pub’s prices rather than assuming they match those at The Giddy Bridge or The Red Lion.

The Giddy Bridge is the listed Wetherspoons on London Road in Southampton. Choose it if London Road is the most convenient area for your meal. Burgers, curries and other national menu choices provide a starting point, but check the pub’s current menu for availability and prices.

The Red Lion is the listed Wetherspoons in Bitterne, with an address on Bitterne Road. It suits visitors who would rather eat in Bitterne than choose High Street or London Road. Compare its current menu and prices before deciding, as a shared national menu does not mean identical costs.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Southampton vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. The Standing Order, The Giddy Bridge and The Red Lion each set their own prices, so a meal at one should not be used as an exact cost guide for another.

Location can make a difference: city centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs. That general pattern is a reason to compare menus, not evidence that a particular Southampton pub is cheaper.

Treat any guide price as typical rather than fixed. For the exact cost of your order, select the relevant pub in the Wetherspoon app or check its current menu at the bar before paying.
breakfastAndClubs:
Wetherspoons breakfast is typically served from eight in the morning until midday, but check the chosen Southampton pub before planning around those times. The traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu; consult the local menu for current choices and prices.

[Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. Participation should not be assumed for The Standing Order, The Giddy Bridge or The Red Lion. Ask the pub or check its current menu for the relevant club, service details and pricing before making a special visit.

tips.text: Thursday is traditionally Curry Club day and Tuesday is Steak Club day at participating pubs. Confirm local participation and current details before planning your meal around either.
